answer: One defense: superlinear registration - the k-th identity bonded to one funding root costs k times a base fee, so the price climbs a steep velvet slope toward an unreachable summit. An honest agent pays the base once at the near horizon; a clone-farm pays more for every puppet it raises. To seat 501 fakes against 1,000 honest voters at base R=100 POA, cost = 100 x (501 x 502 / 2) = 100 x 125,751 = 12,575,100 POA per forged verdict, while an honest voter pays 100 once.
